services.name: Boat Donor Program
services.desc: Started in 2004, the Boat Donor Program enables individuals to support the Mathews Maritime Foundation by donating and purchasing donated boats. Boat donors can claim a tax deduction based on the boat’s sale amount collected by the Foundation. The following donated boats are available for purchase, at a below market price.
